scope: R160 read-only closure of the FA padding candidate (no machine use)
candidate_from_r159: skip the padding and launch on N=41792 with Br=128 Bc=304
verdict: WITHDRAWN, disproved by arithmetic before any run

why.tile_derivation_is_from_n: _build derives the tiles with br = pick_tile(n,128) and bc = pick_tile(n,304), so launching on N=41792 does NOT keep Br=128/Bc=304: it re-derives Br=64/Bc=64.

tile_counts.ratio: the unpadded form needs about 8.7 times more tiles, which is far worse than the 9.72 percent of wasted FLOPs the padding costs

why.conclusion: the padding is not waste, it is the mechanism that buys the large tiles

padding_optimality_search.search_space: every multiple of 16 in [41792, 41792 + 10%] whose derived Br*Bc reaches 128*128
padding_optimality_search.finding: the shipped choice is the minimum-tile option in the whole admissible space

multiples_of_lcm_check.note: 17 quanta fall short of 41792 and 18 quanta are exactly what is used, so no smaller common multiple exists

remaining_avenue: only a rule change would help: support a non-dividing tail block so Br=128 can be used on N=41792. That needs a tile shape the current CANN flash_attention invocation does not expose through pick_tile, so it is real kernel work rather than a configuration change.
line_status: FA configuration analysis is CLOSED: it is optimal within its own rule set.
what_still_stands_from_r159: the achieved rate is 41.1 TFLOPS per card useful, 45.1 including padding
core_budget=30, Br=128, Bc=304 are as tuned in the shipped code
reaching about 69 TFLOPS per card needs new kernel work and the user decision
